description: This Java class is a builder for creating and configuring MedicationDispense objects for testing purposes within the OpenMRS API project. It encapsulates methods to set various attributes of MedicationDispense, utilizing multiple OpenMRS services to fetch related entities.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate the creation and configuration of MedicationDispense objects in testing scenarios.

methods.name: withUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with the MedicationDispense using patient ID.

methods.name: withConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept of the MedicationDispense via concept ID.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Sets the status and optional status reason concepts.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the type concept of the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withEncounter
methods.description: Associates an encounter, setting related location and dispenser.

methods.name: withLocation
methods.description: Sets the location for the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withDrugOrder
methods.description: Associates a drug order with the MedicationDispense, copying relevant info.

methods.name: withDrug
methods.description: Sets the drug and substitution info for the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withDatePrepared
methods.description: Sets the date the MedicationDispense was prepared.

methods.name: withDateHandedOver
methods.description: Sets the date the MedicationDispense was handed over.

methods.name: withFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Sets the form namespace and path.
